topic: What if your shower had a weather forecast?
title: WHAT IF YOUR SHOWER
HAD A FORECAST?

power.rule: the shower shows a water-temperature forecast before you get in — ice, oven, or both at once
power.look: a calm forecast dial in the corner, flipping to a red danger chip when the pressure drops

script.text: That's how people shower every day.
What if your shower had a weather forecast?
You check it before you get in.
While your neighbor shivers from the cold.

script.beat: 4 the not-so-fun part: the cost, one real fact
script.text: But the truth: water at sixty degrees.
And worse when a neighbor opens a tap in the building.
Then a man in a suit opens one.
The forecast changes in a second.
My sister waits outside the door.
So who will turn on your tap? Part 1.

science.claim: الماء عند 60 درجة مئوية يحرق الجلد في نحو ثلاث ثوان.
science.working: البيانات المعيارية للحروق (Moritz and Henriques 1947) تظهر أن الماء بدرجة 60 مئوية (140 فهرنهايت) يسبب حرقا من الدرجة الثالثة خلال نحو 3 ثوان لدى البالغين، وأسرع لدى الأطفال. لهذا توصي لجنة سلامة المستهلك الأمريكية بضبط سخان الماء على 120 فهرنهايت (49 مئوية).
science.source: U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission scald prevention guidance; Moritz & Henriques burn threshold data
